scope: Four reproducible, labelled one-byte perturbations on unmodified power-on corpus input tapes. These are original-reference positives only; no natural occurrence, Rust-body/control-profile admission, or shipping-engine equality is claimed.

single_perturbation.activation: One physical write1 at the authenticated original owner committed WORD A11100=0100
single_perturbation.expiry: One restore0 at the tail of exactly112 actually invoked released/non-reset/non-VDP-halted Z80 ticks following the first original retry-release commit
single_perturbation.semantics: Two one-shot byte writes, never held/reasserted/overlaid; preserve and log intervening writes; first unexpected writer or missing provenance is sticky failure

locator_conventions.frames: zero-based input/video-frame intervals; an instruction may cross a video boundary
locator_conventions.original_instruction_ordinal: actual one-based retired opcode attempts since the proof constructor power-on; not sampled PC or JSR counts
locator_conventions.receipt_cpu_access_ordinal: all original 68000 issued read/write accesses since arming
locator_conventions.receipt_commit_ordinal: all original 68000 physical apply_write dispatches since arming
locator_conventions.lock_read_scoped_access_ordinal: M68k device TimingSurvey accesses since arming; distinct from the complete CPU-access ordinal
locator_conventions.clock_semantics: retained processor counters at their actual hook phase; event_ordinal is chronology, not an inferred physical-console microcycle timestamp

entries.stop_boundary: Immediately after the original owner RTS reaches its retained existing caller frame; no fake return frame or synthetic fragment RTS

independent_replay_verification.comparison: Exact complete structured data, not hashes or projections
